task: show me how to change the cursor type

evidence.description: Brand Kit → Screen Clips page ('Screen Clip Settings') is open with the Cursor Style dropdown expanded, listing the three cursor types

summary:
Walkthrough of where to change the cursor type (cursor style):

1. In the left sidebar, click **Brand Kit** (bottom of the sidebar).
2. In the Brand Kit nav column, choose **Screen Clips** — this opens the brand-wide **Screen Clip Settings** page.
3. Under the **Cursor** section, click the **Cursor Style** dropdown (currently **Pointer-first**).
4. Pick the cursor type you want: **Arrow-first**, **Pointer-first**, or **Original**. The choice applies immediately as the brand default (Default Brand).

I navigated there and opened the dropdown so the three options are visible, but did NOT change the value (no target type was specified) — it remains Pointer-first. Note on scope: this page is the brand-wide default. To change the cursor type for a single project only, open that project → **Project actions ⋯** (next to the voice picker) → **Screen Clip Settings…** → Cursor Style → **Done**; that override is stored separately from the brand default.
